title: Cat/Wins
tagline: Alimentar a un gatito no solo llena su pancita, sino también tu corazón y tu bolsillo. Nuestra plataforma te recompensa con tokens por cada acto de bondad hacia los gatos callejeros
description:
This was a big idea, but i lost access of github then i lost everything, no time to do this again.

I want to create an incentive that makes people receive a token for feeding a cat on the street, the proof? a photograph of them with the can or envelope of food, next to the kitten in question. There will also be people who earn money for verifying that the photo is authentic and that, in fact, a kitten was fed, or is being fed. Those who register profiles of their cats on the platform, those who adopt, those who rescue, or those who have cats in foster care can also earn points.
